subject: Qualification
notes: kb/Work PB1476 (wave 1019 D). Rule 4's antecedent is DataItem.ReferencedByTypeClause, recorded from EVERY written TYPE clause (a storage item's, a linkage item's, another type declaration's member's) before anything expands. Once set, the declaration's members - data-names, condition-names and INDEXED BY index-names alike - join the name's candidates in the ONE lookup (SymbolTable.TryResolve / TryResolveCondition / IndexCandidates) as definitions that count for uniqueness and never resolve alone, except the definition a candidate is itself a copy of (ClonedFrom), which is 13.18.58.4 GR1's one-group case. A type referenced only from a TYPE clause inside another, unreferenced, type declaration therefore lapses the exemption (COBOL1639 for unqualified X; X OF G resolves).
